source.preview_scope: group-level; not a complete variant specification

inference_basis_fields: contentPreview: requests are [sequenceNumber, requestString] pairs; request strings v1/REGISTER/{user}/{initialBalance} and v1/FRIEND_REQUEST/{fromUser}/{toUser} (a pending request stored under its sequence number); further request types and the output format are cut off
problems.inferred_spec: requests is a list of [sequenceNumber, requestString] pairs with unique sequence numbers. Process them in order and return one response string per request. "v1/REGISTER/{user}/{initialBalance}" registers user with that balance and answers "OK", or "ERROR" when user already exists. "v1/FRIEND_REQUEST/{fromUser}/{toUser}" answers "ERROR" when either user is unregistered, the users are equal or already friends; otherwise it stores a pending request under this request's sequence number and answers "OK". "v1/ACCEPT_FRIEND_REQUEST/{requestSequenceNumber}" answers "OK" and makes the two users of that request friends when the number names a still-pending friend request (the request is then no longer pending, and accepting it when the users are already friends through another request is still "OK"); otherwise "ERROR". "v1/TRANSFER/{fromUser}/{toUser}/{amount}" moves amount from fromUser to toUser and answers "OK" when both are registered, distinct, friends, and fromUser's balance is at least amount; otherwise "ERROR" with no change. "v1/BALANCE/{user}" answers the user's balance in decimal, or "ERROR" when unregistered.
problems.inference_uncertainty: very high: the request pair shape, REGISTER and pending FRIEND_REQUEST keyed by sequence number are in the preview; the accept, transfer and balance request formats, the friendship requirement for transfers, the "OK"/"ERROR" response strings and all failure rules are inferred
